Name: Crafting Recipes
Author: JiangJiangCc
Description:
This mod allows you to learn all crafting recipes directly.

通过模组可以直接学习所有的制造配方。
[size=5]

Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]

按R调出模组菜单，再次按R关闭

Press R to open the menu; Press again to exit.

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later;
[/list]
